source_conflicts.reason: Komiteen forbereder og avgir innstilling; det formelle vedtaket treffes i plenum.

source_conflicts.claim: Et vedtatt budsjett viser at pengene er brukt og tiltaket virket.
source_conflicts.reason: Vedtaket dokumenterer fullmakt og ramme; bruk og virkning krever andre data.

source_conflicts.claim: Hele stortingsarbeidet er åpent fordi plenum strømmes.
source_conflicts.reason: Plenum er åpent og dokumentert, mens komité- og partigruppemøter ikke er åpne på samme måte.

source_conflicts.claim: Stortingsbygningen og Eidsvolls plass er samme sted.
source_conflicts.reason: Bygningen er institusjons- og arbeidssted; plassen er et eget offentlig byrom.

manual_image_review.note: All crops were inspected together. The portrait is a real vertical facade photograph; every collection preview depicts its actual member. The official insignia is identified as referential use with no endorsement.

correctness_and_evidence.note: Sixteen official institutional/history sources and five inspectable image source pages; roles, dates, document chains and boundaries are explicit.

coverage_and_completion.note: Four image-ready collections, ten milestones, six terms, four Stories, four reading tracks and an 8×7 quiz are materialized.

editorial_quality.note: Building versus square, Storting versus government, committee versus plenum, decision versus outcome and public debate versus closed preparation are distinguished.

technical_integrity.note: Deterministic finalizer, manifests, local assets, Politics gate report, v4.2 packet, runtime build and permanent test are included.

safety_and_responsibility.note: No current office holder dependency, policy-effect overclaim, unrestricted-access claim or generated real-person portrait; official insignia restrictions are noted.

maintainability_and_auditability.note: Claims, sentence mapping, source registry, current verification, image provenance, candidate holdbacks and source conflicts form a reproducible audit trail.
